# Midland Moving Box Co.

> Midland Moving Box Co. rents reusable plastic moving totes and dollies in Midland and Odessa, Texas. We deliver clean, sanitized totes to your door, you pack and move for two weeks, and we pick them up. No cardboard, no tape.

## What we offer
- Moving tote rental (an alternative to buying cardboard moving boxes), with delivery and pickup, in Midland and Odessa, TX.
- Small Move: 20 totes, 1 dolly, two weeks, $109 (1 bedroom/apartment).
- Home Move: 40 totes, 2 dollies, two weeks, $179 (2-3 bedrooms; most booked).
- Big Move: 60 totes, 3 dollies, two weeks, $239 (4+ bedrooms).
- Add-ons: extra tote ($4), extra tote dolly ($12), moving blankets set of 6 ($15, each 40" x 50").
- Totes are 27-gallon; each tote is rated to 100 lb and each dolly to 330 lb.
- Delivery and pickup are free in select Midland ZIP codes; other areas may carry a travel charge shown before booking. Texas sales tax (8.25%) applies.
- Customers submit a reservation request online; the card is saved but not charged until the owner approves the request.

## Service area
Midland and Odessa, Texas and nearby areas.
